falsification: No lawful goal match or viable embedding: this family/interface is ineffective here.
Equal or higher total cost without more checked successes: no practical benefit in this pilot.
Generic primitive backward agenda achieves the same improvement: no evidence that mined clusters caused it.
Ordinary benefits equally or more: no distinct GCTS advantage.
Handwritten identical template matches performance: no evidence of superiority over human schema design.
Only right-one replay succeeds: training/debug validation only, no recipient transfer.
acceptance_and_falsification.mechanism: At least one actual goal match has an initially pending input later discharged by automatically found original primitives; whole expanded word independently accepted and full rollback controls pass.
acceptance_and_falsification.useful_transfer: On the prospective recipient the family adds a checked success within the unchanged budget, or reduces inclusive cost for the same success versus primitive-only goal search; record all repetitions and UNKNOWNs.

algorithm: Output-match the actual mined context to an existing goal formula with simultaneous typed substitution. Enumerate every still-unbound role through exact current licensed recipe preimages in canonical order; no top-k or donor-ground-term default.

Retain two ordered input obligations even when formulas alias. Reuse a genuinely complete selected proof when present; otherwise reserve a strict-prior unfilled row as PENDING. No unknown premise becomes a fact, axiom or checked consequence.

Ground all three members to original recipe identities and validate their complete original t/m union and current exclusions. No available recipe or embedding means NoInstance advice only; every canonical base alternative remains.

Keep an unattached advice agenda separate from actual point state. Only applying original primitive keys activates their ordinary formula/offset m and unit t. In the fixed24 model these rows are already active; their formula requirements become specific. Never add free fixed marks or silently switch to a variable-boundary model.

Before every committed constituent return to complete global dead, then forced, then earliest-generation selection. A family may reorder compatible incident alternatives only at the selected branch. No atomic macro skips propagation or crosses to a later obligation.

After input obligations acquire complete primitive ancestry, expand the entire shared DAG once, rebase ordered strict-prior references, keep all original Gamma occurrences and check original generalization freshness. Count actual primitive rows, not macro count; close with unchanged independent checker.

Trail advice bindings, pending/resolved status, row reservations and shared-key identity together with original totals, marks/refcounts, domains, generations and exclusions. Undo the complete transaction. Timeout/cancel is UNKNOWN; it is not an exhausted child or new global nogood.
authorship_disclosure: Author of earlier arithmetic kernel/catalogue, ordinary/point producers and intake/report work. This is a Source/saved-data research design, not independent review of those implementations or a new actual result.

comparison.fairness: Same recipient grammar/checker/word limit/native envelope and identical information, deterministic role/embedding order and full fallback. No family-exclusive proof route, target-specific ranking, library expansion counted as one primitive, or RL.
comparison.handwritten_control: Label an explicitly hand-authored identical context schema separately, if used. Identical resulting proposals should have identical logical effects. A gain shared with that arm demonstrates the utility of the fragment, not that learning outperforms human lemma design.
comparison.historical_reference: Fresh ordinary first-ready and canonical point BASE are useful references; published prior attempts are not paired recipient timings.
comparison.mechanism_ablation: Point selected-facts-only arm receives the exact same mined family. Compare with open attachment to isolate unresolved-input access; do not compare two different family recognizers.

interface_gap.effect: This blocks that family API from attaching to a goal before its input proofs exist. It does not mean original point search lacks primitive backward reads: original m can already require a formula at an unfilled prior row.
interface_gap.fact_boundary: Current e499 instantiate_transport requires both keys selected and dependency-complete (lines470-476). Preserve that API and strict fact admission.
interface_gap.no_proof_or_route: Do not serialize the known ordinary word into the recipient library, select a privileged intermediate term from it, or use a human target backcone.
interface_gap.proposed_API: propose_for_goal(*, goal_formula, goal_row, family, catalogue, state) -> provisional data only
interface_gap.recommended_change: One separate provisional propose_for_goal path, not a relaxation of fact checks or a new inference rule.

negative_controls: Pending input with no selected source must never pass fact/proof admission.
Circular, future-row, reversed MP-port or stale-epoch proposal rejected; exact repeated ports retained.
Wrong arity, undeclared parameter or capture-unsafe substitution rejected; full original Gamma freshness remains.
Incompatible assigned-zero mark, shared-key double occupancy or excluded key rejected with exact union/refcounts.
Distant dead and global forced decisions outrank cluster preference; all canonical fallback members remain.
Failed/cancelled/late cluster transaction restores full graph and advice state; UNKNOWN never licenses exhausted-child exclusion.
No-recipient-match or out-of-grammar family produces no advice, not an impossibility result.
Wrong final target or unresolved ancestry rejected by the unchanged independent checker.
next_implementation: Implement only provisional goal matching/ordered pending obligations for existing e499 mined data, plus equal-information ordinary consumption. Preserve selected-fact expansion and independent proof checker. No general custody framework is proposed.
